[31m+ export function reconcileCategoryOrder([39m
[31m+   activeCategories: readonly MenuCategory[],[39m
[31m+   preference: WorkerUiPreferences | null,[39m
[31m+ ): readonly MenuCategory[] {[39m
[31m+   if (preference === null || preference.categoryOrder.length === 0) return activeCategories;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const byId = new Map(activeCategories.map((category) => [category.id, category]));[39m
[31m+   const reconciled: MenuCategory[] = [];[39m
[31m+   const seen = new Set<MenuCategoryId>();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   for (const categoryId of preference.categoryOrder) {[39m
[31m+     const category = byId.get(categoryId);[39m
[31m+     if (category === undefined || seen.has(categoryId)) continue;[39m
[31m+     reconciled.push(category);[39m
[31m+     seen.add(categoryId);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   for (const category of activeCategories) {[39m
[31m+     if (seen.has(category.id)) continue;[39m
[31m+     reconciled.push(category);[39m
[31m+     seen.add(category.id);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return reconciled;[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ export function productFamiliesForCategory([39m
[31m+   products: readonly Product[],[39m
[31m+   categoryId: MenuCategoryId | null,[39m
[31m+ ): readonly string[] {[39m
[31m+   if (categoryId === null) return [];[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const seen = new Set<string>();[39m
[31m+   const families: string[] = [];[39m
[31m+   const categoryProducts = products[39m
[31m+     .filter((product) => product.active && product.categoryId === categoryId)[39m
[31m+     .slice()[39m
[31m+     .sort((left, right) => left.sortOrder - right.sortOrder);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   for (const product of categoryProducts) {[39m
[31m+     const family = product.family?.trim();[39m
[31m+     if (!family || seen.has(family)) continue;[39m
[31m+     seen.add(family);[39m
[31m+     families.push(family);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return families;[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ export function filterProductsForMenu([39m
[31m+   products: readonly Product[],[39m
[31m+   options: {[39m
[31m+     readonly selectedCategoryId: MenuCategoryId | null;[39m
[31m+     readonly selectedFamily: string | null;[39m
[31m+     readonly search: string;[39m
[31m+   },[39m
[31m+ ): readonly Product[] {[39m
[31m+   const active = products.filter((product) => product.active);[39m
[31m+   const query = options.search.trim().toLocaleLowerCase();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (query.length > 0) {[39m
[31m+     return active[39m
[31m+       .filter((product) => product.name.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(query))[39m
[31m+       .slice()[39m
[31m+       .sort((left, right) => left.sortOrder - right.sortOrder);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (options.selectedCategoryId === null) return [];[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return active[39m
[31m+     .filter((product) => product.categoryId === options.selectedCategoryId)[39m
[31m+     .filter([39m
[31m+       (product) => options.selectedFamily === null || product.family === options.selectedFamily,[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+     .slice()[39m
[31m+     .sort((left, right) => left.sortOrder - right.sortOrder);[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function ProductImage({ product }: { readonly product: Product }) {[39m
[31m+   const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false);[39m
[31m+   if (product.imageKey === null || failed) {[39m
[31m+     return ([39m
[31m+       <div className="product-image-fallback" aria-hidden="true">[39m
[31m+         {product.name[39m
[31m+           .split(/\s+/)[39m
[31m+           .slice(0, 2)[39m
[31m+           .map((part) => part.slice(0, 1).toUpperCase())[39m
[31m+           .join('')}[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     <img[39m
[31m+       className="product-image"[39m
[31m+       src={product.imageKey}[39m
[31m+       alt=""[39m
[31m+       loading="lazy"[39m
[31m+       onError={() => setFailed(true)}[39m
[31m+     />[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function QuickInfo({[39m
[31m+   product,[39m
[31m+   busy,[39m
[31m+   onClose,[39m
[31m+ }: {[39m
[31m+   readonly product: Product;[39m
[31m+   readonly busy: boolean;[39m
[31m+   readonly onClose: () => void;[39m
[31m+ }) {[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     <div[39m
[31m+       className="orders-overlay"[39m
[31m+       role="presentation"[39m
[31m+       onMouseDown={(event) => {[39m
[31m+         if (event.currentTarget === event.target && !busy) onClose();[39m
[31m+       }}[39m
[31m+     >[39m
[31m+       <section[39m
[31m+         className="quick-info"[39m
[31m+         role="dialog"[39m
[31m+         aria-modal="true"[39m
[31m+         aria-labelledby="quick-info-title"[39m
[31m+       >[39m
[31m+         <div className="quick-info-media">[39m
[31m+           <ProductImage product={product} />[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+         <div className="quick-info-body">[39m
[31m+           <span className="drawer-kicker">Quick Info</span>[39m
[31m+           <h2 id="quick-info-title">{product.name}</h2>[39m
[31m+           <strong>{formatMoneyMinor(product.priceMinor)}</strong>[39m
[31m+           <p>{product.description?.trim() || 'No product description has been added yet.'}</p>[39m
[31m+           {product.soldOut ? <span className="sold-out-label">Sold Out</span> : null}[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+         <div className="drawer-footer">[39m
[31m+           <button type="button" className="secondary-action" disabled={busy} onClick={onClose}>[39m
[31m+             Close[39m
[31m+           </button>[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+       </section>[39m
[31m+     </div>[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ export function OrdersWorkspace({[39m
[31m+   session,[39m
[31m+   client,[39m
[31m+ }: {[39m
[31m+   readonly session: ActiveSession;[39m
[31m+   readonly client: OperationsOrdersClient;[39m
[31m+ }) {[39m
[31m+   const draftScopeId = useMemo(resolveOrdersDraftScopeId, []);[39m
[31m+   const preferencesClient = useMemo(createWorkerUiPreferencesClient, []);[39m
[31m+   const searchRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);[39m
[31m+   const draftRef = useRef<OrderDraft | null>(null);[39m
[31m+   const saveQueueRef = useRef<Promise<void>>(Promise.resolve());[39m
[31m+   const pendingSaveCountRef = useRef(0);[39m
[31m+   const undoTimerRef = useRef<number | null>(null);[39m
[31m+   const cartResizeRef = useRef<{ startX: number; startWidth: number } | null>(null);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const [workspace, setWorkspace] = useState<OrdersWorkspaceData | null>(null);[39m
[31m+   const [draft, setDraft] = useState<OrderDraft | null>(null);[39m
[31m+   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);[39m
[31m+   const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);[39m
[31m+   const [placing, setPlacing] = useState(false);[39m
[31m+   const [reprinting, setReprinting] = useState(false);[39m
[31m+   const [printNotice, setPrintNotice] = useState<PrintNoticeState | null>(null);[39m
[31m+   const [globalError, setGlobalError] = useState<string | null>(null);[39m
[31m+   const [successMessage, setSuccessMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);[39m
[31m+   const [selectedCategoryId, setSelectedCategoryId] = useState<MenuCategoryId | null>(null);[39m
[31m+   const [selectedFamily, setSelectedFamily] = useState<string | null>(null);[39m
[31m+   const [search, setSearch] = useState('');[39m
[31m+   const [categoryMode, setCategoryMode] = useState<'IDLE' | 'SEARCH'>('IDLE');[39m
[31m+   const [menuEditActive, setMenuEditActive] = useState(false);[39m
[31m+   const [categoryPreference, setCategoryPreference] = useState<WorkerUiPreferences | null>(null);[39m
[31m+   const [categoryEditOrder, setCategoryEditOrder] = useState<readonly MenuCategoryId[]>([]);[39m
[31m+   const [categoryEditAlignment, setCategoryEditAlignment] = useState<CategoryAlignment>('left');[39m
[31m+   const [draggedCategoryId, setDraggedCategoryId] = useState<MenuCategoryId | null>(null);[39m
[31m+   const [menuEditProductOrder, setMenuEditProductOrder] = useState<readonly ProductId[]>([]);[39m
[31m+   const [draggedProductId, setDraggedProductId] = useState<ProductId | null>(null);[39m
[31m+   const [menuEditSaving, setMenuEditSaving] = useState(false);[39m
[31m+   const [menuEditError, setMenuEditError] = useState<string | null>(null);[39m
[31m+   const [menuEditResetRequested, setMenuEditResetRequested] = useState(false);[39m
[31m+   const [customizer, setCustomizer] = useState<ProductCustomizerTarget | null>(null);[39m
[31m+   const [quickInfoProductId, setQuickInfoProductId] = useState<ProductId | null>(null);[39m
[31m+   const [showValidation, setShowValidation] = useState(false);[39m
[31m+   const [clearConfirmOpen, setClearConfirmOpen] = useState(false);[39m
[31m+   const [undo, setUndo] = useState<UndoState | null>(null);[39m
[31m+   const [mobileCartOpen, setMobileCartOpen] = useState(false);[39m
[31m+   const [desktopCartResizable, setDesktopCartResizable] = useState(desktopCartResizeMatches);[39m
[31m+   const [cartWidth, setCartWidth] = useState(() =>[39m
[31m+     typeof window === 'undefined'[39m
[31m+       ? CART_WIDTH_MIN[39m
[31m+       : readCartWidth(window.localStorage, window.innerWidth),[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function commitCartWidth(nextWidth: number): void {[39m
[31m+     const next = clampCartWidth(nextWidth, window.innerWidth);[39m
[31m+     setCartWidth(next);[39m
[31m+     writeCartWidth(window.localStorage, next);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function setCurrentDraft(next: OrderDraft): void {[39m
[31m+     draftRef.current = next;[39m
[31m+     setDraft(next);[39m
[31m+     setWorkspace((current) => (current === null ? null : { ...current, draft: next }));[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   useEffect(() => {[39m
[31m+     let cancelled = false;[39m
[31m+     setLoading(true);[39m
[31m+     setGlobalError(null);[39m
[31m+     void client.loadWorkspace(draftScopeId).then((result) => {[39m
[31m+       if (cancelled) return;[39m
[31m+       setLoading(false);[39m
[31m+       if (!result.ok) {[39m
[31m+         setGlobalError(result.error.message);[39m
[31m+         return;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       setWorkspace(result.value);[39m
[31m+       if (result.value.recoveryState === 'PREVIOUS_ORDER_ALREADY_SAVED') {[39m
[31m+         setSuccessMessage('Previous order was already saved. A new cart is ready.');[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       draftRef.current = result.value.draft;[39m
[31m+       setDraft(result.value.draft);[39m
[31m+       const categories = result.value.configuration.categories[39m
[31m+         .filter((category) => category.active)[39m
[31m+         .sort((left, right) => left.sortOrder - right.sortOrder);[39m
[31m+       const defaultCategoryId = categories[0]?.id ?? null;[39m
[31m+       setSelectedCategoryId((current) =>[39m
[31m+         current !== null && categories.some((category) => category.id === current)[39m
[31m+           ? current[39m
[31m+           : defaultCategoryId,[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+       setSelectedFamily(null);[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+     return () => {[39m
[31m+       cancelled = true;[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+   }, [client, draftScopeId, session.businessDayId, session.operator.id]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   useEffect(() => {[39m
[31m+     let cancelled = false;[39m
[31m+     setCategoryPreference(null);[39m
[31m+     setCategoryMode('IDLE');[39m
[31m+     setMenuEditActive(false);[39m
[31m+     setMenuEditError(null);[39m
[31m+     setMenuEditResetRequested(false);[39m
[31m+     setSearch('');[39m
[31m+     void preferencesClient[39m
[31m+       .load()[39m
[31m+       .then((preference) => {[39m
[31m+         if (!cancelled) setCategoryPreference(preference);[39m
[31m+       })[39m
[31m+       .catch(() => {[39m
[31m+         if (!cancelled) setCategoryPreference(null);[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+     return () => {[39m
[31m+       cancelled = true;[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+   }, [preferencesClient, session.operator.id]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   useEffect(() => {[39m
[31m+     if (categoryMode === 'SEARCH') searchRef.current?.focus();[39m
[31m+   }, [categoryMode]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   useEffect(() => {[39m
[31m+     function onKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent): void {[39m
[31m+       const target = event.target;[39m
[31m+       const targetIsEditor =[39m
[31m+         target instanceof HTMLInputElement ||[39m
[31m+         target instanceof HTMLTextAreaElement ||[39m
[31m+         target instanceof HTMLSelectElement;[39m
[31m+       if ((event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) && event.key.toLowerCase() === 'k') {[39m
[31m+         if (menuEditActive) return;[39m
[31m+         event.preventDefault();[39m
[31m+         setCategoryMode('SEARCH');[39m
[31m+         return;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       if (event.key === '/' && !targetIsEditor && !menuEditActive) {[39m
[31m+         event.preventDefault();[39m
[31m+         setCategoryMode('SEARCH');[39m
[31m+         return;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       if (event.key === 'Escape' && categoryMode === 'SEARCH') {[39m
[31m+         event.preventDefault();[39m
[31m+         if (search.length > 0) {[39m
[31m+           setSearch('');[39m
[31m+           searchRef.current?.focus();[39m
[31m+         } else {[39m
[31m+           setCategoryMode('IDLE');[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);[39m
[31m+     return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);[39m
[31m+   }, [categoryMode, menuEditActive, search]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   useEffect([39m
[31m+     () => () => {[39m
[31m+       if (undoTimerRef.current !== null) window.clearTimeout(undoTimerRef.current);[39m
[31m+     },[39m
[31m+     [],[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   useEffect(() => {[39m
[31m+     const media = window.matchMedia(DESKTOP_CART_RESIZE_QUERY);[39m
[31m+     const sync = () => setDesktopCartResizable(media.matches);[39m
[31m+     sync();[39m
[31m+     media.addEventListener('change', sync);[39m
[31m+     return () => media.removeEventListener('change', sync);[39m
[31m+   }, []);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   useEffect(() => {[39m
[31m+     function clampToViewport(): void {[39m
[31m+       if (!desktopCartResizeMatches()) return;[39m
[31m+       setCartWidth((current) => {[39m
[31m+         const next = clampCartWidth(current, window.innerWidth);[39m
[31m+         if (next !== current) writeCartWidth(window.localStorage, next);[39m
[31m+         return next;[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     clampToViewport();[39m
[31m+     window.addEventListener('resize', clampToViewport);[39m
[31m+     return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', clampToViewport);[39m
[31m+   }, []);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function beginPendingSave(): void {[39m
[31m+     pendingSaveCountRef.current += 1;[39m
[31m+     setSaving(true);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function endPendingSave(): void {[39m
[31m+     pendingSaveCountRef.current = Math.max(0, pendingSaveCountRef.current - 1);[39m
[31m+     if (pendingSaveCountRef.current === 0) setSaving(false);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function enqueueMutation(mutation: DraftMutation): void {[39m
[31m+     beginPendingSave();[39m
[31m+     const run = saveQueueRef.current.then(async () => {[39m
[31m+       const current = draftRef.current;[39m
[31m+       if (current === null) return;[39m
[31m+       let proposed: OrderDraft;[39m
[31m+       try {[39m
[31m+         proposed = mutation(current);[39m
[31m+       } catch (error) {[39m
[31m+         setGlobalError([39m
[31m+           error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Could not update the order draft.',[39m
[31m+         );[39m
[31m+         return;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       if (proposed === current) return;[39m
[31m+       setCurrentDraft(proposed);[39m
[31m+       const result = await client.saveDraft(proposed);[39m
[31m+       if (!result.ok) {[39m
[31m+         setCurrentDraft(current);[39m
[31m+         setGlobalError(result.error.message);[39m
[31m+         return;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       setCurrentDraft(result.value);[39m
[31m+       setGlobalError(null);[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+     saveQueueRef.current = run[39m
[31m+       .catch((error: unknown) => {[39m
[31m+         setGlobalError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Could not save the order draft.');[39m
[31m+       })[39m
[31m+       .finally(endPendingSave);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function showUndo(snapshot: OrderDraft, message: string): void {[39m
[31m+     if (undoTimerRef.current !== null) window.clearTimeout(undoTimerRef.current);[39m
[31m+     setUndo({ snapshot, message });[39m
[31m+     undoTimerRef.current = window.setTimeout(() => {[39m
[31m+       setUndo(null);[39m
[31m+       undoTimerRef.current = null;[39m
[31m+     }, 7_000);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function undoLastDraftChange(): void {[39m
[31m+     const currentUndo = undo;[39m
[31m+     if (currentUndo === null) return;[39m
[31m+     if (undoTimerRef.current !== null) window.clearTimeout(undoTimerRef.current);[39m
[31m+     undoTimerRef.current = null;[39m
[31m+     setUndo(null);[39m
[31m+     enqueueMutation((current) => restoreDraftContents(current, currentUndo.snapshot));[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const configuration = workspace?.configuration ?? null;[39m
[31m+   const configuredActiveCategories = useMemo([39m
[31m+     () =>[39m
[31m+       configuration?.categories[39m
[31m+         .filter((category) => category.active)[39m
[31m+         .sort((left, right) => left.sortOrder - right.sortOrder) ?? [],[39m
[31m+     [configuration],[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+   const activeCategories = useMemo([39m
[31m+     () => reconcileCategoryOrder(configuredActiveCategories, categoryPreference),[39m
[31m+     [categoryPreference, configuredActiveCategories],[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+   const categoryAlignment = categoryPreference?.categoryAlignment ?? 'left';[39m
[31m+   const categoryEditorCategories = useMemo(() => {[39m
[31m+     const byId = new Map(configuredActiveCategories.map((category) => [category.id, category]));[39m
[31m+     return categoryEditOrder.flatMap((categoryId) => {[39m
[31m+       const category = byId.get(categoryId);[39m
[31m+       return category === undefined ? [] : [category];[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+   }, [categoryEditOrder, configuredActiveCategories]);[39m
[31m+   const activeFamilies = useMemo(() => {[39m
[31m+     const selectedCategory = activeCategories.find([39m
[31m+       (category) => category.id === selectedCategoryId,[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+     if (selectedCategory?.name.trim().toLocaleLowerCase() !== 'burgers') return [];[39m
[31m+     return productFamiliesForCategory(configuration?.products ?? [], selectedCategoryId);[39m
[31m+   }, [activeCategories, configuration, selectedCategoryId]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   useEffect(() => {[39m
[31m+     if (selectedFamily !== null && !activeFamilies.includes(selectedFamily)) {[39m
[31m+       setSelectedFamily(null);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }, [activeFamilies, selectedFamily]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const products = useMemo([39m
[31m+     () =>[39m
[31m+       filterProductsForMenuWithPreference([39m
[31m+         configuration?.products ?? [],[39m
[31m+         {[39m
[31m+           selectedCategoryId,[39m
[31m+           selectedFamily,[39m
[31m+           search,[39m
[31m+         },[39m
[31m+         categoryPreference,[39m
[31m+       ),[39m
[31m+     [categoryPreference, configuration, search, selectedCategoryId, selectedFamily],[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+   const menuEditProducts = useMemo(() => {[39m
[31m+     if (selectedCategoryId === null) return [];[39m
[31m+     const byId = new Map([39m
[31m+       (configuration?.products ?? [])[39m
[31m+         .filter((product) => product.active)[39m
[31m+         .map((product) => [product.id, product]),[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+     return menuEditProductOrder.flatMap((productId) => {[39m
[31m+       const product = byId.get(productId);[39m
[31m+       return product !== undefined && product.categoryId === selectedCategoryId ? [product] : [];[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+   }, [configuration, menuEditProductOrder, selectedCategoryId]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const validation = useMemo(() => {[39m
[31m+     if (draft === null || configuration === null) return null;[39m
[31m+     return validateOrderDraft(draft, configuration);[39m
[31m+   }, [configuration, draft]);[39m
[31m+   const visibleIssues: readonly OrderValidationIssue[] =[39m
[31m+     showValidation && validation !== null && !validation.valid ? validation.issues : [];[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const totalQuantity = draft?.lines.reduce((total, line) => total + line.quantity, 0) ?? 0;[39m
[31m+   const quickInfoProduct =[39m
[31m+     quickInfoProductId === null[39m
[31m+       ? null[39m
[31m+       : (configuration?.products.find((product) => product.id === quickInfoProductId) ?? null);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function beginMenuEdit(): void {[39m
[31m+     setCategoryMode('IDLE');[39m
[31m+     setSearch('');[39m
[31m+     setSelectedFamily(null);[39m
[31m+     setMenuEditError(null);[39m
[31m+     setMenuEditResetRequested(false);[39m
[31m+     setCategoryEditOrder(activeCategories.map((category) => category.id));[39m
[31m+     setCategoryEditAlignment(categoryAlignment);[39m
[31m+     setMenuEditProductOrder([39m
[31m+       reconcileProductOrder(configuration?.products ?? [], categoryPreference).map([39m
[31m+         (product) => product.id,[39m
[31m+       ),[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+     setDraggedCategoryId(null);[39m
[31m+     setDraggedProductId(null);[39m
[31m+     setMenuEditActive(true);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function resetMenuEdit(): void {[39m
[31m+     setCategoryEditOrder(configuredActiveCategories.map((category) => category.id));[39m
[31m+     setCategoryEditAlignment('left');[39m
[31m+     setMenuEditProductOrder([39m
[31m+       reconcileProductOrder(configuration?.products ?? [], null).map((product) => product.id),[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+     setDraggedCategoryId(null);[39m
[31m+     setDraggedProductId(null);[39m
[31m+     setMenuEditError(null);[39m
[31m+     setMenuEditResetRequested(true);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function cancelMenuEdit(): void {[39m
[31m+     if (menuEditSaving) return;[39m
[31m+     setMenuEditActive(false);[39m
[31m+     setDraggedCategoryId(null);[39m
[31m+     setDraggedProductId(null);[39m
[31m+     setMenuEditError(null);[39m
[31m+     setMenuEditResetRequested(false);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   async function saveMenuEdit(): Promise<void> {[39m
[31m+     if (menuEditSaving) return;[39m
[31m+     setMenuEditSaving(true);[39m
[31m+     setMenuEditError(null);[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const saved = await preferencesClient.update([39m
[31m+         menuEditPreferenceInput([39m
[31m+           categoryEditOrder,[39m
[31m+           categoryEditAlignment,[39m
[31m+           menuEditProductOrder,[39m
[31m+           menuEditResetRequested,[39m
[31m+         ),[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+       setCategoryPreference(saved);[39m
[31m+       setMenuEditActive(false);[39m
[31m+       setMenuEditResetRequested(false);[39m
[31m+       setDraggedCategoryId(null);[39m
[31m+       setDraggedProductId(null);[39m
[31m+       setSuccessMessage('Menu layout saved');[39m
[31m+       window.setTimeout(() => setSuccessMessage(null), 4_500);[39m
[31m+     } catch {[39m
[31m+       setMenuEditError('Could not save menu layout. Try again.');[39m
[31m+     } finally {[39m
[31m+       setMenuEditSaving(false);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function moveDraggedCategory(targetId: MenuCategoryId): void {[39m
[31m+     const sourceId = draggedCategoryId;[39m
[31m+     if (sourceId === null || sourceId === targetId) return;[39m
[31m+     setMenuEditResetRequested(false);[39m
[31m+     setCategoryEditOrder((current) => {[39m
[31m+       const sourceIndex = current.indexOf(sourceId);[39m
[31m+       const targetIndex = current.indexOf(targetId);[39m
[31m+       if (sourceIndex < 0 || targetIndex < 0) return current;[39m
[31m+       const next = [...current];[39m
[31m+       const [moved] = next.splice(sourceIndex, 1);[39m
[31m+       if (moved === undefined) return current;[39m
[31m+       next.splice(targetIndex, 0, moved);[39m
[31m+       return next;[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function moveDraggedProduct(targetId: ProductId): void {[39m
[31m+     const sourceId = draggedProductId;[39m
[31m+     if (sourceId === null || sourceId === targetId || selectedCategoryId === null) return;[39m
[31m+     setMenuEditResetRequested(false);[39m
[31m+     const productCategoryById = new Map([39m
[31m+       (configuration?.products ?? []).map((product) => [product.id, product.categoryId]),[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+     setMenuEditProductOrder((current) => {[39m
[31m+       const categoryProductIds = current.filter([39m
[31m+         (productId) => productCategoryById.get(productId) === selectedCategoryId,[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+       return moveProductWithinCategory(current, categoryProductIds, sourceId, targetId);[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function addProduct(product: Product): void {[39m
[31m+     if (draftRef.current === null || configuration === null || product.soldOut) return;[39m
[31m+     if (product.isCombo) {[39m
[31m+       setCustomizer({ kind: 'ADD', productId: product.id });[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     enqueueMutation((current) =>[39m
[31m+       addProductUnit({[39m
[31m+         draft: current,[39m
[31m+         configuration,[39m
[31m+         productId: product.id,[39m
[31m+         lineId: parseEntityId<DraftLineId>(crypto.randomUUID()),[39m
[31m+         addedSequence: nextDraftAddedSequence(current),[39m
[31m+       }),[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function decrementProduct(product: Product): void {[39m
[31m+     const current = draftRef.current;[39m
[31m+     if (current === null || productQuantityInDraft(current, product.id) === 0) return;[39m
[31m+     showUndo(current, `Removed one ${product.name}`);[39m
[31m+     enqueueMutation((candidate) => decrementProductUnit(candidate, product.id));[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function decrementLine(lineId: DraftLineId): void {[39m
[31m+     const current = draftRef.current;[39m
[31m+     const line = current?.lines.find((candidate) => candidate.id === lineId);[39m
[31m+     if (current === null || line === undefined) return;[39m
[31m+     showUndo(current, `Removed one ${line.productName}`);[39m
[31m+     enqueueMutation((candidate) => decrementDraftLine(candidate, lineId));[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function incrementLine(lineId: DraftLineId): void {[39m
[31m+     if (draftRef.current === null || configuration === null) return;[39m
[31m+     enqueueMutation((current) =>[39m
[31m+       duplicateDraftLineUnit({[39m
[31m+         draft: current,[39m
[31m+         configuration,[39m
[31m+         lineId,[39m
[31m+         newLineId: parseEntityId<DraftLineId>(crypto.randomUUID()),[39m
[31m+         addedSequence: nextDraftAddedSequence(current),[39m
[31m+       }),[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function submitCustomization(customization: DraftLineCustomization): void {[39m
[31m+     if (customizer === null || configuration === null) return;[39m
[31m+     if (customizer.kind === 'ADD') {[39m
[31m+       const target = customizer;[39m
[31m+       enqueueMutation((current) =>[39m
[31m+         addProductUnit({[39m
[31m+           draft: current,[39m
[31m+           configuration,[39m
[31m+           productId: target.productId,[39m
[31m+           lineId: parseEntityId<DraftLineId>(crypto.randomUUID()),[39m
[31m+           addedSequence: nextDraftAddedSequence(current),[39m
[31m+           customization,[39m
[31m+         }),[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+     } else {[39m
[31m+       const target = customizer;[39m
[31m+       enqueueMutation((current) =>[39m
[31m+         replaceDraftLineCustomization({[39m
[31m+           draft: current,[39m
[31m+           lineId: target.lineId,[39m
[31m+           configuration,[39m
[31m+           customization,[39m
[31m+         }),[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     setCustomizer(null);[39m
[31m+     setQuickInfoProductId(null);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function confirmClear(): void {[39m
[31m+     const current = draftRef.current;[39m
[31m+     if (current === null) return;[39m
[31m+     showUndo(current, 'Order cleared');[39m
[31m+     enqueueMutation((candidate) => ({[39m
[31m+       ...candidate,[39m
[31m+       lines: [],[39m
[31m+       orderNote: null,[39m
[31m+       discountMinor: ZERO_MONEY,[39m
[31m+       delivery: {[39m
[31m+         ...candidate.delivery,[39m
[31m+         displayPhone: '',[39m
[31m+         normalizedPhone: '',[39m
[31m+         customerName: '',[39m
[31m+         address: '',[39m
[31m+         zoneId: null,[39m
[31m+         zoneLabel: '',[39m
[31m+         configuredFeeMinor: ZERO_MONEY,[39m
[31m+         finalFeeMinor: ZERO_MONEY,[39m
[31m+       },[39m
[31m+       payment: { mode: 'NONE' },[39m
[31m+     }));[39m
[31m+     setClearConfirmOpen(false);[39m
[31m+     setShowValidation(false);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function commitDeliveryPhone(displayPhone: string): void {[39m
[31m+     if (configuration === null || workspace === null) return;[39m
[31m+     const normalized = normalizeEgyptianPhone(displayPhone);[39m
[31m+     enqueueMutation((current) => ({[39m
[31m+       ...current,[39m
[31m+       delivery: {[39m
[31m+         ...current.delivery,[39m
[31m+         displayPhone,[39m
[31m+         normalizedPhone: normalized.normalizedPhone,[39m
[31m+       },[39m
[31m+     }));[39m
[31m+     if (!normalized.valid) return;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const normalizedPhone = normalized.normalizedPhone;[39m
[31m+     void saveQueueRef.current.then(async () => {[39m
[31m+       const result = await client.findCustomerByPhone(workspace.shopId, normalizedPhone);[39m
[31m+       if (!result.ok) {[39m
[31m+         setGlobalError(result.error.message);[39m
[31m+         return;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       const contact = result.value;[39m
[31m+       if (contact === null) return;[39m
[31m+       enqueueMutation((current) => {[39m
[31m+         if (current.delivery.normalizedPhone !== normalizedPhone) return current;[39m
[31m+         const zone =[39m
[31m+           contact.latestZoneId === null[39m
[31m+             ? null[39m
[31m+             : (configuration.deliveryZones.find([39m
[31m+                 (candidate) => candidate.id === contact.latestZoneId && candidate.active,[39m
[31m+               ) ?? null);[39m
[31m+         const withContact: OrderDraft = {[39m
[31m+           ...current,[39m
[31m+           delivery: {[39m
[31m+             ...current.delivery,[39m
[31m+             customerName: contact.name,[39m
[31m+             address: contact.latestAddress ?? current.delivery.address,[39m
[31m+           },[39m
[31m+         };[39m
[31m+         return zone === null[39m
[31m+           ? withContact[39m
[31m+           : {[39m
[31m+               ...withContact,[39m
[31m+               delivery: {[39m
[31m+                 ...withContact.delivery,[39m
[31m+                 zoneId: zone.id,[39m
[31m+                 zoneLabel: zone.name,[39m
[31m+                 configuredFeeMinor: zone.feeMinor,[39m
[31m+                 finalFeeMinor: zone.feeMinor,[39m
[31m+               },[39m
[31m+             };[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   async function placeOrder(): Promise<void> {[39m
[31m+     await saveQueueRef.current;[39m
[31m+     const current = draftRef.current;[39m
[31m+     if (current === null || configuration === null) return;[39m
[31m+     const checked = validateOrderDraft(current, configuration);[39m
[31m+     if (!checked.valid) {[39m
[31m+       setShowValidation(true);[39m
[31m+       setGlobalError(checked.issues[0]?.message ?? 'Check the order details.');[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     setPlacing(true);[39m
[31m+     setGlobalError(null);[39m
[31m+     const result = await client.placeOrder(current);[39m
[31m+     setPlacing(false);[39m
[31m+     if (!result.ok) {[39m
[31m+       setShowValidation(true);[39m
[31m+       setGlobalError(result.error.message);[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     setCurrentDraft(result.value.nextDraft);[39m
[31m+     setShowValidation(false);[39m
[31m+     setSearch('');[39m
[31m+     setMobileCartOpen(false);[39m
[31m+     setUndo(null);[39m
[31m+     const prefix = result.value.replayed ? 'Recovered' : 'Placed';[39m
[31m+     setSuccessMessage(`${prefix} order #${result.value.order.displayOrderNo}`);[39m
[31m+     window.setTimeout(() => setSuccessMessage(null), 4_500);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const printFailed = result.value.postCommitWarnings.includes('PRINT_FAILED');[39m
[31m+     const printUnknown = result.value.postCommitWarnings.includes('PRINT_STATUS_UNKNOWN');[39m
[31m+     if (printFailed || printUnknown) {[39m
[31m+       setPrintNotice({[39m
[31m+         orderId: result.value.order.id,[39m
[31m+         displayOrderNo: result.value.order.displayOrderNo,[39m
[31m+         kind: printFailed ? 'FAILED' : 'UNKNOWN',[39m
[31m+         message: printFailed[39m
[31m+           ? 'The order is saved locally, but the receipt did not print.'[39m
[31m+           : 'The order was recovered safely. Receipt print status is unknown, so it was not printed again automatically.',[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+     } else {[39m
[31m+       setPrintNotice(null);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const otherWarnings = result.value.postCommitWarnings.filter([39m
[31m+       (warning) => warning !== 'PRINT_FAILED' && warning !== 'PRINT_STATUS_UNKNOWN',[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+     if (otherWarnings.length > 0) {[39m
[31m+       setGlobalError([39m
[31m+         `Order #${result.value.order.displayOrderNo} is saved locally. Follow-up issue: ${otherWarnings.join(', ')}`,[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   async function reprintReceipt(): Promise<void> {[39m
[31m+     const notice = printNotice;[39m
[31m+     if (notice === null || reprinting) return;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     setReprinting(true);[39m
[31m+     const result = await client.reprintOrder(notice.orderId);[39m
[31m+     setReprinting(false);[39m
[31m+     if (!result.ok) {[39m
[31m+       setPrintNotice({[39m
[31m+         ...notice,[39m
[31m+         kind: 'FAILED',[39m
[31m+         message: `Order #${notice.displayOrderNo} is still saved locally. ${result.error.message}`,[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     setPrintNotice(null);[39m
[31m+     setSuccessMessage(`Receipt reprinted for order #${result.value.displayOrderNo}`);[39m
[31m+     window.setTimeout(() => setSuccessMessage(null), 4_500);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (loading) {[39m
[31m+     return <main className="orders-loading" aria-label="Loading Orders" />;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (workspace === null || draft === null || configuration === null) {[39m
[31m+     return ([39m
[31m+       <main className="orders-unavailable">[39m
[31m+         <h1>Orders unavailable</h1>[39m
[31m+         <p>{globalError ?? 'The local Orders workspace could not be loaded.'}</p>[39m
[31m+       </main>[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const busy = saving || placing;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     <main[39m
[31m+       className="orders-workspace"[39m
[31m+       style={[39m
[31m+         desktopCartResizable[39m
[31m+           ? { gridTemplateColumns: `minmax(0, 1fr) 0.5rem ${cartWidth}px` }[39m
[31m+           : undefined[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     >[39m
[31m+       <section className="menu-pane" aria-label="Menu">[39m
[31m+         <>[39m
[31m+           <div[39m
[31m+             className={[39m
[31m+               menuEditActive[39m
[31m+                 ? 'menu-toolbar category-mode-edit'[39m
[31m+                 : `menu-toolbar category-mode-${categoryMode.toLowerCase()}`[39m
[31m+             }[39m
[31m+           >[39m
[31m+             <div className="field-stack category-navigation-stack">[39m
[31m+               <div className="category-navigation">[39m
[31m+                 <div[39m
[31m+                   className="category-rail"[39m
[31m+                   aria-label="Menu categories"[39m
[31m+                   data-alignment={menuEditActive ? categoryEditAlignment : categoryAlignment}[39m
[31m+                 >[39m
[31m+                   {(menuEditActive ? categoryEditorCategories : activeCategories).map([39m
[31m+                     (category) => ([39m
[31m+                       <button[39m
[31m+                         type="button"[39m
[31m+                         key={category.id}[39m
[31m+                         className={[[39m
[31m+                           'category-tab',[39m
[31m+                           selectedCategoryId === category.id ? 'selected' : '',[39m
[31m+                           menuEditActive ? 'category-tab-reordering' : '',[39m
[31m+                           draggedCategoryId === category.id ? 'category-tab-dragging' : '',[39m
[31m+                         ][39m
[31m+                           .filter(Boolean)[39m
[31m+                           .join(' ')}[39m
[31m+                         draggable={menuEditActive && draggedCategoryId !== category.id}[39m
[31m+                         onDragStart={(event) => {[39m
[31m+                           if (!menuEditActive) return;[39m
[31m+                           setDraggedCategoryId(category.id);[39m
[31m+                           event.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';[39m
[31m+                           event.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', category.id);[39m
[31m+                         }}[39m
[31m+                         onDragEnter={(event) => {[39m
[31m+                           if (!menuEditActive || draggedCategoryId === null) return;[39m
[31m+                           event.preventDefault();[39m
[31m+                           moveDraggedCategory(category.id);[39m
[31m+                         }}[39m
[31m+                         onDragOver={(event) => {[39m
[31m+                           if (menuEditActive && draggedCategoryId !== null) event.preventDefault();[39m
[31m+                         }}[39m
[31m+                         onDragEnd={() => setDraggedCategoryId(null)}[39m
[31m+                         onDrop={(event) => {[39m
[31m+                           event.preventDefault();[39m
[31m+                           setDraggedCategoryId(null);[39m
[31m+                         }}[39m
[31m+                         onClick={() => {[39m
[31m+                           setSelectedCategoryId(category.id);[39m
[31m+                           setSelectedFamily(null);[39m
[31m+                           setSearch('');[39m
[31m+                         }}[39m
[31m+                       >[39m
[31m+                         {category.name}[39m
[31m+                       </button>[39m
[31m+                     ),[39m
[31m+                   )}[39m
[31m+                 </div>[39m
[31m+                 <div className="category-nav-actions">[39m
[31m+                   {menuEditActive ? ([39m
[31m+                     <div[39m
[31m+                       className="category-alignment category-alignment-inline"[39m
[31m+                       role="group"[39m
[31m+                       aria-label="Category alignment"[39m
[31m+                     >[39m
[31m+                       {(['left', 'center', 'right'] as const).map((alignment) => ([39m
[31m+                         <button[39m
[31m+                           type="button"[39m
[31m+                           key={alignment}[39m
[31m+                           aria-pressed={categoryEditAlignment === alignment}[39m
[31m+                           onClick={() => {[39m
[31m+                             setCategoryEditAlignment(alignment);[39m
[31m+                             setMenuEditResetRequested(false);[39m
[31m+                           }}[39m
[31m+                         >[39m
[31m+                           {alignment === 'left'[39m
[31m+                             ? 'Left'[39m
[31m+                             : alignment === 'center'[39m
[31m+                               ? 'Center'[39m
[31m+                               : 'Right'}[39m
[31m+                         </button>[39m
[31m+                       ))}[39m
[31m+                     </div>[39m
[31m+                   ) : null}[39m
[31m+                   {categoryMode === 'IDLE' ? ([39m
[31m+                     <button[39m
[31m+                       type="button"[39m
[31m+                       className={[39m
[31m+                         menuEditActive[39m
[31m+                           ? 'category-icon-action category-edit-active'[39m
[31m+                           : 'category-icon-action'[39m
[31m+                       }[39m
[31m+                       aria-label="Edit menu"[39m
[31m+                       title="Edit menu"[39m
[31m+                       aria-pressed={menuEditActive}[39m
[31m+                       onClick={() => {[39m
[31m+                         if (!menuEditActive) beginMenuEdit();[39m
[31m+                       }}[39m
[31m+                     >[39m
[31m+                       <EditPencilIcon />[39m
[31m+                     </button>[39m
[31m+                   ) : null}[39m
[31m+                   {!menuEditActive && categoryMode === 'SEARCH' ? ([39m
[31m+                     <div className="product-search category-search-inline">[39m
[31m+                       <SearchIcon className="category-search-glyph" />[39m
[31m+                       <input[39m
[31m+                         ref={searchRef}[39m
[31m+                         id="product-search"[39m
[31m+                         type="search"[39m
[31m+                         aria-label="Search menu"[39m
[31m+                         value={search}[39m
[31m+                         placeholder="Search products"[39m
[31m+                         autoComplete="off"[39m
[31m+                         onChange={(event) => setSearch(event.target.value)}[39m
[31m+                       />[39m
[31m+                       <button[39m
[31m+                         type="button"[39m
[31m+                         className="category-search-clear"[39m
[31m+                         aria-label="Clear search"[39m
[31m+                         title="Clear search"[39m
[31m+                         onClick={() => {[39m
[31m+                           setSearch('');[39m
[31m+                           setCategoryMode('IDLE');[39m
[31m+                         }}[39m
[31m+                       >[39m
[31m+                         ×[39m
[31m+                       </button>[39m
[31m+                     </div>[39m
[31m+                   ) : !menuEditActive ? ([39m
[31m+                     <button[39m
[31m+                       type="button"[39m
[31m+                       className="category-icon-action"[39m
[31m+                       aria-label="Search menu"[39m
[31m+                       title="Search menu"[39m
[31m+                       onClick={() => setCategoryMode('SEARCH')}[39m
[31m+                     >[39m
[31m+                       <SearchIcon />[39m
[31m+                     </button>[39m
[31m+                   ) : null}[39m
[31m+                 </div>[39m
[31m+               </div>[39m
[31m+               {!menuEditActive && activeFamilies.length > 0 ? ([39m
[31m+                 <div[39m
[31m+                   className="segmented-control product-family-filter"[39m
[31m+                   aria-label="Product families"[39m
[31m+                 >[39m
[31m+                   <button[39m
[31m+                     type="button"[39m
[31m+                     className={selectedFamily === null ? 'selected' : undefined}[39m
[31m+                     onClick={() => setSelectedFamily(null)}[39m
[31m+                   >[39m
[31m+                     All[39m
[31m+                   </button>[39m
[31m+                   {activeFamilies.map((family) => ([39m
[31m+                     <button[39m
[31m+                       type="button"[39m
[31m+                       key={family}[39m
[31m+                       className={selectedFamily === family ? 'selected' : undefined}[39m
[31m+                       onClick={() => setSelectedFamily(family)}[39m
[31m+                     >[39m
[31m+                       {family}[39m
[31m+                     </button>[39m
[31m+                   ))}[39m
[31m+                 </div>[39m
[31m+               ) : null}[39m
[31m+             </div>[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           <div className="product-grid" aria-live="polite">[39m
[31m+             {menuEditActive ? ([39m
[31m+               menuEditProducts.length === 0 ? ([39m
[31m+                 <div className="menu-empty">[39m
[31m+                   <strong>No products found</strong>[39m
[31m+                   <span>This category has no active products.</span>[39m
[31m+                 </div>[39m
[31m+               ) : ([39m
[31m+                 menuEditProducts.map((product) => ([39m
[31m+                   <article[39m
[31m+                     key={product.id}[39m
[31m+                     className={[[39m
[31m+                       'product-card',[39m
[31m+                       'menu-edit-product-card',[39m
[31m+                       draggedProductId === product.id ? 'menu-edit-product-card-dragging' : '',[39m
[31m+                     ][39m
[31m+                       .filter(Boolean)[39m
[31m+                       .join(' ')}[39m
[31m+                     draggable={menuEditActive && draggedProductId !== product.id}[39m
[31m+                     tabIndex={0}[39m
[31m+                     aria-label={`Reorder ${product.name}`}[39m
[31m+                     onDragStart={(event) => {[39m
[31m+                       setDraggedProductId(product.id);[39m
[31m+                       event.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';[39m
[31m+                       event.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', product.id);[39m
[31m+                     }}[39m
[31m+                     onDragEnter={(event) => {[39m
[31m+                       if (draggedProductId === null) return;[39m
[31m+                       event.preventDefault();[39m
[31m+                       moveDraggedProduct(product.id);[39m
[31m+                     }}[39m
[31m+                     onDragOver={(event) => {[39m
[31m+                       if (draggedProductId !== null) event.preventDefault();[39m
[31m+                     }}[39m
[31m+                     onDragEnd={() => setDraggedProductId(null)}[39m
[31m+                     onDrop={(event) => {[39m
[31m+                       event.preventDefault();[39m
[31m+                       setDraggedProductId(null);[39m
[31m+                     }}[39m
[31m+                   >[39m
[31m+                     <div className="product-main">[39m
[31m+                       <div className="product-media">[39m
[31m+                         <ProductImage product={product} />[39m
[31m+                       </div>[39m
[31m+                       <div className="product-copy">[39m
[31m+                         <strong>{product.name}</strong>[39m
[31m+                         {product.description?.trim() ? <p>{product.description}</p> : null}[39m
[31m+                       </div>[39m
[31m+                       <strong className="product-price">[39m
